purpose: Fresh-machine build inputs for the Windows application and unsigned Squirrel.Windows package.

tools.name: node
tools.verification: node --version must be exactly v24.19.0 and npm --version must be available

projectDependencies.server: HomeAssistantAcDefender.csproj and its NuGet lock state
projectDependencies.signing: disabled by policy; no certificate, key, or signer is downloaded

containerPackages.repositoryProof: noble-updates Packages.gz independently listed both exact versions for amd64 and arm64 during this correction pass

portableFallback.reason: Pinned .NET SDK/runtime and Node.js official portable ZIP fallbacks install under user-scoped LOCALAPPDATA roots without UAC.

notes: Tool installation pins the canonical winget source, which enforces its package-manifest installer hashes, then uses verified official portable ZIP fallbacks for .NET and Node.js; it never prints credentials or triggers UAC in silent mode.
If neither winget nor the verified portable fallback can provide a pinned tool, the script stops with the exact missing tool instead of claiming bootstrap success.
